日文.首段: 西鉄1300形電車（にしてつ1300けいでんしゃ）は、西日本鉄道（西鉄）がかつて所有していた電車の一形式である。

章节.概要:
大牟田線（現・天神大牟田線）の特急電車増発用として1961年に4両編成2本が製造された。新たに製造された中間電動車2両と、600形（初代）の先頭車モ600・ク650から改造された制御車2両からなる。

※カッコ内は改造前の番号
章节.構造:
中間車（モ1300形…1302・1303・1306・1307）は車体・台車とも完全な新製で、1000形の中間車とほぼ同一形状の全普通鋼製の車体である。側扉は片開き2扉、側面窓は二段上昇窓。側面窓配置は1D(1)6(1)D1（D=客用扉、数字は窓の枚数、カッコ内は戸袋窓）である。貫通路の横幅は旧600形のク1300形に合わせるため1000形より100 mm 短い1000 mm となっている。
制御車（ク1300形…1301・1304・1305・1308）は600形（初代）の先頭車を更新整備した半鋼製車体である。前面は国鉄モハ52系をツリ目にした感じの流線形4枚窓で、側面窓配置はdD12D2（d=乗務員室扉、D=客用扉、数字は窓の枚数）。窓枠をアルミサッシに取り替え、戸袋窓は1枚ガラスの固定窓となったほか、扉を鋼製扉に取り替えた。台車は中間車と同じメーカーで新製した台車に履き替えている。
座席配置は1000形と同じく、扉間は向かいあわせの固定クロスシート（ボックスシート）で、扉周辺（車端部の運転室と扉の間、連結面と扉の間、中間車の戸袋窓部分、先頭車の戸袋窓とその隣の窓の部分）はロングシートとなっている。
特急用として使用されるため、車体塗装は当初から1000形と同じコバルトブルーに黄色帯であった。
メーカーは1301F（F=編成）が近畿車輛、1305Fが日本車輌製造である。台車も中間車の車体とそれぞれ同じメーカーにより製造されており、近畿車輛製の1301編成が同社製KD-29系（電動車がKD-29B、制御車がKD-29C）、日本車輌製の1305編成は同社製ND-304台車を装備する。
中間電動車2両はユニット方式となっており、大牟田寄りの中間車1302・1306に主制御器とパンタグラフ1基を設置し、福岡・太宰府寄りの中間車1303・1307に電動発電機と電動空気圧縮機を設置した。主電動機出力は1000形が80kWであったのに対し、本形式は110kWに上げられたが、全電動車方式の1000形と違い両端が制御車の2M2T編成であるため電動機の個数が1000形の半分しかないことから、総出力は1000形の約7割程度であった。
章节.運用:
製造当初は特急用として使用されたが、2000形の製造により特急運用を離脱し、1978年頃に塗装をアイスグリーン地に赤帯（ボンレッド）の塗色に改められた上で一般車両に格下げされた。しかし先頭車が半鋼製の狭窓車体であることから3扉化が困難なため2扉のままで、座席もロングシートを増設した以外はクロスシートのままであった。また先頭車の車体構造上、冷房化改造も実施されなかった。
このため1985年に大牟田線の営業用稼働車両の全面冷房化を実施した際に運用から外された。構造上、宮地岳線への転用改造もできず、1986年に廃車となった。

中文.首段: 西铁1300型电车（にしてつ1300けいでんしゃ）是西日本铁道（西铁）过去所拥有的一种电车形式。

章节.概要:
1961年为增加大牟田线（现·天神大牟田线）特急电车的班次，制造了2列4辆编组。由新造的2辆中间动车，以及由600型（初代）头车莫600、克650改造而成的2辆控制车组成。
※括号内为改造前的编号
章节.结构: 中间车（莫1300型…1302、1303、1306、1307）的车体和转向架均为完全新造，是车体与1000型的中间车几乎相同形状的全普通钢制车体。侧门为单开2门，侧面窗为两段上推窗。侧面窗布置为1D(1)6(1)D1（D=客用门，数字为窗户数量，括号内为门袋窗）。贯通通道的宽度为了配合旧600型的克1300型，比1000型短100 mm，为1000 mm。控制车（克1300型…1301、1304、1305、1308）是将600型（初代）的头车进行更新整修后的半钢制车体。前面是给人国铁莫哈52系“吊眼”感觉的流线型4扇窗，侧面窗布置为dD12D2（d=乘务员室门，D=客用门，数字为窗户数量）。窗框更换为铝制窗框，门袋窗成为单片玻璃的固定窗，并将车门更换为钢制门。转向架则更换为与中间车同一厂商新造的转向架。座席布置与1000型相同，车门之间为面对面的固定横排座（箱式座），车门周围（车端部驾驶室与车门之间、连结面与车门之间、中间车的门袋窗部分、头车的门袋窗及其相邻窗户部分）为长条座。由于作为特急使用，车体涂装从一开始就与1000型相同，为钴蓝色配黄色色带。制造商为：1301F（F=编组）由近畿车辆制造，1305F由日本车辆制造。转向架也分别由与中间车车体相同的制造商制造，近畿车辆制造的1301编组装备该公司制造的KD-29系（动车为KD-29B，控制车为KD-29C），日本车辆制造的1305编组装备该公司制造的ND-304转向架。2辆中间动车采用单元方式，在大牟田一侧的中间车1302、1306上安装主控制器和1台受电弓，在福冈·太宰府一侧的中间车1303、1307上安装电动发电机和电动空气压缩机。主电动机输出方面，1000型为80kW，而本型提高到110kW，但与全动车方式的1000型不同，本型两端为控制车的2M2T编组，因此电动机数量只有1000型的一半，总输出约为1000型的7成左右。
章节.运用: 制造当初作为特急使用，但因2000型的制造而退出特急运用，1978年前后将涂装改为冰绿色底配红色色带（枣红色）的涂色，并降级为一般车辆。但由于头车是半钢制的窄窗车体，难以改为3门，因此保持2门，座席也仅增设了长条座，其余仍为横排座。此外，由于头车的车体结构，也未进行冷气化改造。因此，1985年大牟田线营业运用车辆全面冷气化时，本型被排除在运用之外。由于结构原因也无法改造转用于宫地岳线，于1986年报废。

英文.首段: The Nishitetsu 1300 series (Nishitetsu 1300-kei densha) is a type of electric car formerly owned by Nishi-Nippon Railroad (Nishitetsu).

章节.Overview:
In 1961, two four-car sets were built to increase the frequency of limited express trains on the Omuta Line (now the Tenjin Omuta Line). They consisted of two newly built intermediate motor cars and two control cars converted from the lead cars Mo 600 and Ku 650 of the 600 series (first generation).
* Numbers in parentheses are the numbers before conversion.
章节.Structure: The intermediate cars (Mo 1300 series... 1302, 1303, 1306, 1307) were completely newly built in both body and truck, with all-ordinary-steel bodies of almost the same shape as the intermediate cars of the 1000 series. The side doors are single-leaf two-door, and the side windows are two-stage rising windows. The side window arrangement is 1D(1)6(1)D1 (D = passenger door; numbers are the number of windows; parentheses are door-pocket windows). The width of the gangway was made 1,000 mm, 100 mm shorter than the 1000 series, to match the Ku 1300 series of the old 600 series. The control cars (Ku 1300 series... 1301, 1304, 1305, 1308) have semi-steel bodies made by updating and refurbishing the lead cars of the 600 series (first generation). The front is a streamlined four-window design reminiscent of a 'slanted-eye' version of the JNR Moha 52 series, and the side window arrangement is dD12D2 (d = crew-room door, D = passenger door, numbers are the number of windows). The window frames were replaced with aluminum sashes, the door-pocket windows became single-pane fixed windows, and the doors were replaced with steel doors. The trucks were replaced with newly built trucks from the same manufacturer as the intermediate cars. The seat arrangement is the same as the 1000 series: between the doors there are fixed facing cross seats (box seats), and around the doors (between the cab and the door at the car ends, between the coupling face and the door, the door-pocket window part of the intermediate cars, and the door-pocket window and the adjacent window of the lead cars) there is longitudinal seating. Because it was used for limited express service, the body livery was from the beginning the same as the 1000 series: cobalt blue with a yellow band. The manufacturers were Kinki Sharyo for 1301F (F = formation) and Nippon Sharyo for 1305F. The trucks were also manufactured by the same manufacturer as the respective intermediate car bodies: the Kinki Sharyo-built 1301 set is equipped with that company's KD-29 series (KD-29B for the motor car, KD-29C for the control car), and the Nippon Sharyo-built 1305 set is equipped with that company's ND-304 trucks. The two intermediate motor cars were of the unit system, with the main controller and one pantograph installed on intermediate cars 1302 and 1306 toward Omuta, and the motor-generator and motor-driven air compressor installed on intermediate cars 1303 and 1307 toward Fukuoka and Dazaifu. As for the main motor output, while the 1000 series was 80 kW, this type was raised to 110 kW, but unlike the all-motor-car 1000 series, this type was a 2M2T formation with control cars at both ends, so the number of motors was only half that of the 1000 series, and the total output was about 70% of the 1000 series.
章节.Operation: It was used for limited express service at first, but with the construction of the 2000 series it left limited express service, and around 1978 its livery was changed to an ice-green base with a red band (bon red) and it was downgraded to a general car. However, since the lead cars had semi-steel narrow-window bodies, converting them to three doors was difficult, so they remained two-door, and the seats also remained cross seats except that longitudinal seats were added. In addition, because of the body structure of the lead cars, air-conditioning conversion was not carried out either. For this reason, when the Omuta Line carried out full air-conditioning of its revenue-service cars in 1985, the type was removed from service. Structurally it could not be converted for use on the Miyatake Line either, and it was scrapped in 1986.

英文.全文:
Nishitetsu 1300 series electric car

The Nishitetsu 1300 series (Nishitetsu 1300-kei densha) is a type of electric car formerly owned by Nishi-Nippon Railroad (Nishitetsu).

== Overview ==
In 1961, two four-car sets were built to increase the frequency of limited express trains on the Omuta Line (now the Tenjin Omuta Line). They consisted of two newly built intermediate motor cars and two control cars converted from the lead cars Mo 600 and Ku 650 of the 600 series (first generation).
* Numbers in parentheses are the numbers before conversion.

== Structure ==
The intermediate cars (Mo 1300 series... 1302, 1303, 1306, 1307) were completely newly built in both body and truck, with all-ordinary-steel bodies of almost the same shape as the intermediate cars of the 1000 series. The side doors are single-leaf two-door, and the side windows are two-stage rising windows. The side window arrangement is 1D(1)6(1)D1 (D = passenger door; numbers are the number of windows; parentheses are door-pocket windows). The width of the gangway was made 1,000 mm, 100 mm shorter than the 1000 series, to match the Ku 1300 series of the old 600 series.
The control cars (Ku 1300 series... 1301, 1304, 1305, 1308) have semi-steel bodies made by updating and refurbishing the lead cars of the 600 series (first generation). The front is a streamlined four-window design reminiscent of a 'slanted-eye' version of the JNR Moha 52 series, and the side window arrangement is dD12D2 (d = crew-room door, D = passenger door, numbers are the number of windows). The window frames were replaced with aluminum sashes, the door-pocket windows became single-pane fixed windows, and the doors were replaced with steel doors. The trucks were replaced with newly built trucks from the same manufacturer as the intermediate cars.
The seat arrangement is the same as the 1000 series: between the doors there are fixed facing cross seats (box seats), and around the doors (between the cab and the door at the car ends, between the coupling face and the door, the door-pocket window part of the intermediate cars, and the door-pocket window and the adjacent window of the lead cars) there is longitudinal seating.
Because it was used for limited express service, the body livery was from the beginning the same as the 1000 series: cobalt blue with a yellow band.
The manufacturers were Kinki Sharyo for 1301F (F = formation) and Nippon Sharyo for 1305F. The trucks were also manufactured by the same manufacturer as the respective intermediate car bodies: the Kinki Sharyo-built 1301 set is equipped with that company's KD-29 series (KD-29B for the motor car, KD-29C for the control car), and the Nippon Sharyo-built 1305 set is equipped with that company's ND-304 trucks.
The two intermediate motor cars were of the unit system, with the main controller and one pantograph installed on intermediate cars 1302 and 1306 toward Omuta, and the motor-generator and motor-driven air compressor installed on intermediate cars 1303 and 1307 toward Fukuoka and Dazaifu. As for the main motor output, while the 1000 series was 80 kW, this type was raised to 110 kW, but unlike the all-motor-car 1000 series, this type was a 2M2T formation with control cars at both ends, so the number of motors was only half that of the 1000 series, and the total output was about 70% of the 1000 series.

== Operation ==
It was used for limited express service at first, but with the construction of the 2000 series it left limited express service, and around 1978 its livery was changed to an ice-green base with a red band (bon red) and it was downgraded to a general car. However, since the lead cars had semi-steel narrow-window bodies, converting them to three doors was difficult, so they remained two-door, and the seats also remained cross seats except that longitudinal seats were added. In addition, because of the body structure of the lead cars, air-conditioning conversion was not carried out either.
For this reason, when the Omuta Line carried out full air-conditioning of its revenue-service cars in 1985, the type was removed from service. Structurally it could not be converted for use on the Miyatake Line either, and it was scrapped in 1986.
